events.title: HSBNE Night Tour
events.description: A guided tour of Brisbane's premier makerspace, HSBNE, showing off their industrial workshops, electronics labs, and creative community tools. Perfect for those interested in joining a maker culture.

events.title: HSBNE Social Saturdays
events.description: A weekly open-access day at the HSBNE makerspace where members and visitors gather to work on personal projects, share knowledge, and socialise. An ideal environment for hands-on collaboration.

events.title: Kate Foster: A River I Must Be Book Launch
events.description: An intimate evening with author Kate Foster discussing her latest work, her creative process, and the themes behind the book. Includes audience Q&A and a chance to meet fellow literature enthusiasts.
